features.title: Remove unsafe credential handling and make doctor truthful
features.description: Secrets do not need to appear in command arguments, custom credential-file mutation is removed or safely deprecated, and doctor distinguishes local configuration evidence from verified authentication.
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_cli.py tests/test_provider_modal.py tests/test_cli_schema.py tests/test_modal_adapters.py: 142 passed

features.title: Make retries operation-aware and CLI errors specific
features.description: Only safe operations retry typed transient failures, mutating operations are not repeated after ambiguous failures, and SDK exception subclasses map to documented CLI JSON categories.

features.title: Reconcile release records, quality evidence, and active plan state
features.description: Plugin and package versions have explicit sources of truth, current docs agree, the onboarding manual gate is resolved, and the quality score reflects the 0.4.1 surface.

features.title: Add direct boundary tests and strengthen typing
features.description: Schema, Modal adapters, provider error translation, and retry policy have focused direct tests, with stricter typing adopted in bounded module groups.

features.title: Clarify CLI, SDK, provider, and test ownership boundaries
features.description: Large modules are separated by coherent responsibility behind compatible public entry points, and tests are organized by behavior rather than accumulated in monolithic files.

features.title: Preview resolved live behavior without creating resources
features.description: Users and agents can inspect redacted resolved configuration, lifecycle, network, volume, and resource-creation behavior before running a live command.

features.title: Evaluate the next workflow convenience with evidence
features.description: Project profiles, sandbox status and cleanup, and bounded project upload/run are compared for value, safety, compatibility, and maintenance cost; at most one is promoted into a separate initiative.
